## WIPO × Wikimedia — a Wikimedian in Residence programme, 2021 → today

Three residents, four languages, one publication programme. WIPO's Publications and Design Section works with
Wikimedians in Residence who turn its reports, indices and treaty documentation into encyclopedic content — and keep
it current as each new edition appears.

**The team** — [the project's tracking page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/WikiProject:United_Nations/WIPO)

- **Florence Devouard** ([User:Anthere](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Anthere)) — English, French — resident since February 2022
- **Salvador Alcántar** ([User:Salvador alc](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Salvador_alc)) — Spanish — resident since April 2023
- **Mervat Salman** ([User:Mervat](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Mervat)) — Arabic — resident since February 2024

Two earlier residencies preceded the current team (John Cummings, mid-2021; Isla Haddow-Flood and Sherry Antoine, late
2021). The programme's first institutional outcome was a licensing one: WIPO's publications are CC BY, and in 2022 the
website terms of use were updated to match. *(Open-access policy: November 2016.)*

**How to read this board.** The figures in the next card were read on **2 October 2026** from the project's own lists,
Wikimedia search and the Commons Impact Metrics API — they are cumulative and dated. Every other card is **live**: it
re-reads its source every time the board loads.

**On the numbers' quality.** Every Commons category used here is on the [Commons Impact Metrics](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:Commons_Impact_Metrics) allow list — WMF's precomputed monthly dataset, so the figures are exact rather than sampled. Scope is `deep`, which includes the sub-categories in which each resident's uploads live. Where a measurement cannot be made by a card — Massviews publishes no API, and CIM's history for this category tree begins in November 2023 — the card says so rather than approximating.

*Sources: [the project's tracking page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/WikiProject:United_Nations/WIPO) · [the Diff article](https://diff.wikimedia.org/2024/10/31/wipo-wikimedia-partnership-a-success-story/) · [the board guide](https://wikibento.toolforge.org/board-guide.md)*

### Since 2021, in numbers

- **2,408 articles** worked on across four Wikipedias — English 842, French 399, Spanish 608, Arabic 559.
  *The project's own tracking lists (PagePile 105694 / 105693 / 105875 / 105885), read 2 October 2026.*
- **4,429 Wikipedia articles** cite `wipo.int` — English 2,001, Spanish 942, French 803, Arabic 683.
  *Wikimedia search, article space, 2 October 2026.*
- **441 Commons files** uploaded by the residents, 109 of them in use on 177 pages across 46 wikis.
  *Commons Impact Metrics — live card below.*
- **291 Wikidata items** about WIPO publications, 201 of them with WIPO as author.
  *Wikidata SPARQL — live card below.*
- **24.5 million views** of pages using WIPO-produced files, November 2023 → August 2026.
  *Commons Impact Metrics monthly series.*
- **≈37 million views a month** for the 759 English articles worked on.
  *The project's own figure (Massviews over its English list) — reported here, not measured, because Massviews has no API.*

Two of those six have no card, and the reason is worth stating: CIM's monthly history for this category tree begins in
November 2023, and Massviews publishes no JSON. Everything else on this board is live — each live card carries its own
*⏱ updated* line and re-reads on load.

*On the second item: the live card counts **link placements**, and one page can carry several — 1,374 links on French
Wikipedia, against 803 pages found by search. The card labels the former "total pages linking"; the page count is the
one in the list above.*

# The newest WIPO publications with a publication date on Wikidata.
# Labels: en first, mul second — names identical in every language live under `mul` and have no en label.
SELECT ?Publication ?Year WHERE {
  ?item wdt:P123 wd:Q177773 .
  ?item rdfs:label ?Publication . FILTER(LANG(?Publication) IN ("en", "mul"))
  ?item wdt:P577 ?d . BIND(YEAR(?d) AS ?Year)
} ORDER BY DESC(?d) LIMIT 10
